title: DC Finest: Superman: The Man of Steel #1
desc:
THE BEGINNING OF A NEW ERA!

Following Crisis on Infinite Earths, comic book superstar John Byrne reimagined Superman for a new era! Starting with the six-issue Man of Steel miniseries, Byrne fundamentally changed Superman's origins and propelled him into the present, featuring stories with Lex Luthor, Metallo, the Titans, Darkseid, and more!

This title collects The Man of Steel #1-6, Superman #1-6, Adventures of Superman #424-429, Action Comics #584-588, Legends #6, and pages from Legends #1-5 and Hawkman #10.
